encode_queries_dense: encode a list of query strings into dense embeddings using a query encoder and tokenizer
encode_corpus_dense: encode a corpus of documents with title and text fields into dense embeddings using a doc encoder
evaluate_dense_retrieval: evaluate a dense retrieval model on a BEIR dataset and return NDCG, MAP, recall, and precision metrics
create_dense_encoder_model: create a DenseEncoderModel wrapping query and doc encoders with optional text normalization and lowercasing
run_beir_evaluation: run BEIR retrieval evaluation with dense exact search and save results to a specified path
